# Import rules

<!-- Generated by `pnpm gen:rules` from .dependency-cruiser.cjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

An import is allowed only if one of these rules allows it. Anything else fails `pnpm verify`.

| Rule | Allows |
| --- | --- |
| `same-folder` | Any file may import files in its own folder. |
| `app` | app/ (start-up wiring) may import everything. |
| `lab` | lab/ (dev-only tools) may import everything except app/. |
| `testing` | testing/ (fakes, contracts) may import everything; only test files may import it. |
| `tests` | Test files (*.test.ts, *.test.tsx) may also import testing/ and test libraries. |
| `features-core` | features/* may import core/protocols, core/models and core/utils — never core/engine or core/sharing. |
| `features-common` | features/* may import common/*. |
| `features-libraries` | features/* may import React, React Native, React Navigation, safe-area, Reanimated and Gesture Handler. |
| `managers-core` | managers/* may import core/protocols, core/models and core/utils. |
| `managers-map-libraries` | managers/map is the only folder that may import MapLibre (plus React, React Native, Reanimated and the bundled map style). |
| `managers-device-libraries` | managers/device is the only folder that may import expo-battery and modules/rtls-thermal (plus React Native). |
| `managers-storage-libraries` | managers/storage is the only folder that may import AsyncStorage. |
| `managers-photos-libraries` | managers/photos is the only folder that may import the image picker and file system. |
| `common-core` | common/* may import core/protocols, core/models and core/utils. |
| `common-ui-utils` | common/ui may import common/utils. |
| `common-libraries` | common/* may import React, React Native, React Navigation types and safe-area. |
| `core-engine-sharing-sessions` | core/engine, core/sharing and core/sessions may import core/protocols, core/models and core/utils; only app/, lab/ and testing/ may import them. |
| `core-protocols` | core/protocols may import core/models and core/utils. |
| `core-models` | core/models may import core/utils. core/utils imports nothing. |

Always forbidden:

| Rule | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `no-circular` | No import cycles. Move the shared piece down a layer (usually core/models or core/utils). |
| `index-only` | Import another folder only through its index.ts (e.g. '@core/protocols', not '@core/protocols/feed'). Export what you need from that index. |
| `not-to-unresolvable` | This import does not resolve. Check the path alias or install the package with npx expo install. |
